pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

History doesn’t wait for believers. It rewards those who recognize the vision before the world does.

KARDASHEV isn’t here to stay small. Remember that name.

$KARDASHEV is more than just a memecoin. It’s connected to a nonprofit organization founded by Jeff Bezos, and Elon Musk follows the project. 👀

The Kardashev Scale represents humanity’s ambition to advance technologically and harness the power of the universe. This vision aligns with the kind of future Elon has long been associated with.

KARDASHEV is still actively working, hiring new team members, and creating opportunities to reach a wider audience. This isn’t a project simply being left behind.

Think about the potential if this narrative gains mainstream attention. 🌌

Right now, these tokens are incredibly cheap. I’m not here to chase quick profits or sell at the first pump. I’m holding with a long-term vision, and I want to see how far this project can go.

Some bags are meant to be traded. Others are meant to be held for the future. $KARDASHEV is my legacy bag. 🚀
